text: [“] And you shall make an altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and three cubits its height.
And you shall make its horns on its four corners; from it shall be its horns, and you shall overlay it with bronze.
And you shall make its pots for removing its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its firepans; even all its vessels you shall make of bronze.
And you shall make for it a grate of work of net of bronze; and you shall make on the net four bronze rings on its four ends.
And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar from below, and the net shall be up to the middle of the altar.
And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
And the poles shall be brought into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar, when carrying it.
Hollow, of boards, you shall make it; as it was shown you on the mountain; so shall they make [it].
And you shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side, southward, hangings for the court of finely woven linen, a hundred by the cubit the length for the one side.
And its twenty pillars, their twenty bases [are] of bronze, and the hooks of the pillars and their bands [are] silver.

And likewise along the north side in length, hangings a hundred [cubits] long, and with its twenty pillars and their twenty bases of bronze. And the hooks of the pillars and their bands [are] of silver.
And along the width of the court on the west side, hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten bases.
And the width of the court on the east side toward the sunrise [is] fifty cubits.
And the hangings on one side [are] five [and] ten cubits, [with] their three pillars and their three bases.
And on the second side [are] hangings five [and] ten [cubits], [with] their three pillars, and their three bases.
And for the gate of the court [is] a screen twenty cubits [long], of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and finely woven linen, the work of a weaver; [with] its four pillars and its four bases.
All the pillars around the court [shall have] bands of silver, [with] their hooks of silver and their bases of bronze.
The length of the court [is] a hundred by the cubit, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of finely woven linen, and their bases of bronze.
For all the vessels of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the court [are] of bronze.
And you shall command the sons of Israel, and they shall bring to you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.

In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that [is] over the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from evening until morning before the face of YHWH; [it shall be] a statute forever for their generations with the sons of Israel.
